bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed and searched; nonclear bags receive additional screening. Larger bags are not allowed.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue offers valet parking; GreenStreet garage on Clay Street between Main and Fannin provides skybridge access.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue’s FAQ and accessibility page do not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food, local craft beer and a full bar are available during Music Hall shows; outside food and drinks are prohibited. The venue accepts cards and mobile pay, with cash-to-card conversion onsite.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible entrance and parking options are available. The GreenStreet garage connects via a third-floor skybridge; request an interpreter at least two weeks ahead or an assistive listening device at least two days ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Music Hall does not allow re-entry for shows.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Pick up will-call tickets on show day at the box office, which opens one hour before doors. Bring a valid photo ID and the card used to purchase.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: All guests undergo security screening that may include a wand, walk-through detector or pat-down. A Foundation Room purchase of $25 or more per person can qualify for priority entry at most shows.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
